actions: If guard fires BUY. Otherwise argmax of BUY=0, predicted WAIT advantage (when eligible), predicted SKIP advantage. Positive SKIP can terminate immediately. At wait cap choose BUY or SKIP; no forced expiry despite BUY being better than SKIP.

architectures.S1_LINEAR: Two separate Ridge(alpha10) advantage heads WAIT and SKIP; same 43 features plus missing indicators, StandardScaler; WAIT trained on delay0..25; SKIP on0..30. BUY reference advantage0.
architectures.S3_GUARDED_LINEAR: Reuse S1 heads unchanged. Add LogisticRegression(C1,max_iter2000,random_state57) FAST_WINNER guard on same43 features; if predicted probability>=0.5 force BUY; else S1 action. Separate state architecture, not threshold retune.
architectures.fitBudget: 5 supervised fits total: linear2, tree2, guard1. No ablation/hyperparameter/weight rescue.
architectures.weights: Each head total sample weight per episode1. Repeated states not independent samples. TRAIN-only fitting; no refit on Validation or DEV TEST.

authorization: Explicit v2 directive: new objective research; frozen upstream/EXIT and all safety constraints retained.
baselines: B2_v1 frozen LINEAR and TREE failed comparisons from saved ledgers; do not retrain v1
completion: Full Entry+economic+integrity PASS on Validation and chosen DEV TEST -> DEVELOPMENT_FROZEN_NOT_FRESH_VALIDATED. Otherwise COMPREHENSIVE_LONG_ENTRY_V2_DEVELOPMENT_LIMIT_REACHED scoped to tested objectives/architectures; preserve failures, no universal impossibility claim.

economicGate.pairing: Identical opportunity ids per pair. Report no-entry cash0 separately from entered-only. Missing entered outcome is UNKNOWN excluded explicitly, never 0. HOLD/MFE/MAE included.
economicGate.policy: Exact frozen Candidate A + exact Fixed12 fallback, unchanged 0.05pp. New entry starts own fixed12 calendar cap. Signal next-open semantics unchanged.
economicGate.requirements: Economic evaluable >=90% of common baseline; mean net delta>=.05pp, PF nonworse, p05 nonworse; both sources mean delta>=0; >=3/4 blocks net delta>=0; TRAIN-top3 exclusion delta>0.

entryGates.chronological: At least3/4 subblocks commonN>=20, +3/+5 preservation>=.80 where denominator exists, price improvement mean>=0; no subgroup thresholds/rules.
entryGates.cohorts: INITIAL and DIP each complete n>=30, entry coverage>=.60, +3/+5 preservation>=.85, strict30 entered-paired p05 no worse by more than.25pp.
entryGates.concentration: Exclude TRAIN-frequency top3 symbols (tie symbol ascending); same full overall entry gates excluding minimum sample / pullback cohort nesting. No blacklist.
entryGates.pullback: PULLBACK+DEEP_PULLBACK combined n>=10, paired entered mean price improvement>=0.10pp and strict30 median MAE nonworse, +3 preservation>=.85. Deep separately descriptive (tiny n cannot certify).

evaluator.classification: Use exact v1 path_class code, pin its actual executable precedence. Same-bar high/low unknown retained. Additional FAST_WINNER = first completed post-entry bar HIGH>=1 and common60 MFE>=3, evaluator only.
evaluator.coverage: Price reference missing at original opportunity expires as in v1. Missing/absent prefix at later decision expires. OHLC parsing for labels never decides BUY/WAIT/SKIP.
evaluator.execution: B0 original REFERENCE_OPEN. At t decisions use bars.end<=t only; execution reference is bar starting t OPEN. Decision policy never consumes that bar HIGH/LOW/CLOSE. Missing execution OPEN -> EXPIRE.
evaluator.wait: WAIT_ONE_STEP advances exactly five clock minutes then recomputes PIT features/prediction. Max30min. Cannot cross morning/afternoon boundary. Missing completed prefix fails closed. No future snapshot substitution.
evaluator.waitMask: WAIT forbidden at delay30 or t+5>=current segment end. BUY and SKIP remain. Tie priority BUY_NOW, WAIT_ONE_STEP, SKIP_OR_EXPIRE.
evaluator.window: Same v1 common-end original opportunity+60 clock minutes inside same segment, complete only. Strict30 after each entry reported to avoid shorter-horizon MAE confound. All emitted denominators and missing cases retained.

features: Exactly v1 43 features; no additions, no feature selection. Same TRAIN medians/missing-indicators and scaling fit independently to same training population. Anchor snapshots not refreshed by future data.
priorExposure: 76 Development sessions previously exposed to general diagnostics; v1 TRAIN and Validation newly evaluated, internal DEV TEST not evaluated for v1 candidates. Preserve exact dates. No Fresh/OOS equivalence.
scope: 3508 independent opportunity episodes. INITIAL and DIP alternative episodes may share a symbol-session; no aggregated funded portfolio and no actual fills. One terminal BUY or SKIP per episode, no resurrection.
selection: First candidate in fixed order passing Entry and economic Validation gates goes to DEV TEST once. All precommitted Validation candidates may be measured; no post-hoc winner selection. Internal DEV TEST only chosen survivor; failure STOP no replacement.

teacher.buyUtility: U_now = common-end close return -0.05 + 0.25*common-end MAE. Future values are TRAIN evaluator labels only.
teacher.fast_winner_price_chase: FAST_WINNER_now AND next_OPEN>current_OPEN. FAST_WINNER_now=first current bar HIGH>=1 AND common-end MFE>=3.
teacher.guardTarget: Binary FAST_WINNER label, TRAIN only; no feature contamination.
teacher.missed_threshold_penalty: sum_k weight[k]*I(MFE_now>=k AND MFE_next<k). Same common end; each MFE relative to its executable OPEN. Captures lost remaining upside.
teacher.missingNextLabel: Do not label unavailable next outcome as zero or failure. Exclude unavailable transition; fixed 60m-complete baseline training guarantees observed offsets0..30. At delay30 WAIT label not trained; mask at inference.
teacher.notBellmanClaim: One-step delayed-purchase action-value surrogate, re-evaluated sequentially. Not an oracle continuation maximum and not a proof of optimal multistep policy.
teacher.skipAdvantage: -U_now - sum_k(weight[k]*I(MFE_now>=k)) -1.0*FAST_WINNER_now. Skip cash utility minus explicit missed opportunity costs, expressed relative to BUY.
teacher.unit: percentage points, fixed human research design; no weight sweep
teacher.waitAdvantage: U_next_open - U_now - 0.05 one-step delay penalty - missed_threshold_penalty - 1.0*fast_winner_price_chase. Only next scheduled OPEN at t+5, not minimum price or best later utility.

trainFastFail.action: If any fail, KILL before Validation. Record full TRAIN action monitoring, but do not tune.
